user.title: Set up Facade Conductor
user.description: That is all you need to start. Everything else is under Configure later, rooms are added with Add room.

data_description.weather: May stay empty. Without weather there is no heat protection, you can add it later under Configure.

abort.already_configured: Facade Conductor is already set up. Add rooms with Add room.

data_description.weather: Without weather there is no heat protection.
data_description.hot_temperature: If the daily high is above this, heat protection applies.

data_description.lux_sensor: Sensor outdoors, for example on a weather station. Not an indoor sensor. Without a sensor the sun position is used.
data_description.lux_bright: Two thresholds prevent back and forth with passing clouds.

night.title: Night closing
night.description:
During this time the shutters move to their night position.

An open window still keeps its ventilation gap.

behavior.title: Movement
behavior.description:
After an automatic move, a room waits this long before it moves automatically again.

Safety, manual moves and open windows never wait, they act immediately.

data_description.rest_minutes: Prevents back and forth, for example with passing clouds.

positions.title: Default positions
positions.description: Apply to all rooms unless a room sets its own. 0 % is closed, 100 % is open.

error.lux_order: "Dark below" must be lower than "bright above", otherwise the day keeps switching back and forth.

user.title: Add room
user.description: Choose the area. Shutters and window contacts in it are suggested.

room.title: Room {area}
room.description: Check the suggestions. Sleep, own positions and more are set later with Configure on the room.

data_description.direction: Used for heat protection. Not set means no heat protection.

data_description.window_means: A simple contact only knows open or closed.

data_description.direction: Not set means no heat protection in this room.

data.sleep_pause_start: Sleep does not apply here from

data_description.sleep_sensor: While it is on, the room stays dark.
data_description.sleep_pause_start: Optional, for example when an open-plan room should still open at noon.

own_positions.title: Own positions
own_positions.description: Only fill in what differs here. Empty fields use the house defaults.

error.no_covers: Please choose at least one shutter or curtain.

abort.already_configured: There is already a room for this area.

unreachable.title: {cover} unreachable
unreachable.description: {cover} in {room} has been unreachable for 15 minutes. Facade Conductor moves it again once it is back. Check power and the radio connection. This entry disappears by itself.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Set rooms to manual mode until the next phase of the day or until "Resume".

entity_id.name: Rooms
entity_id.description: One entity per room, e.g. its manual switch. Empty means all rooms.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: End manual mode. Without rooms, an alarm ends too.

entity_id.name: Rooms
entity_id.description: One entity per room, e.g. its manual switch. Empty means all rooms.

wake.name: Wake
wake.description: For these rooms, night and sleep end now, until noon.

entity_id.name: Rooms
entity_id.description: One entity per room, e.g. its manual switch. Empty means all rooms.

alarm.name: Alarm
alarm.description: All rooms to one position, like a safety trigger. Without a position the alarm ends.
